tasks.title: Conversation #72
tasks.transcript:
Man: Christy, hey I'm glad I bumped into you. I'm starting a side hustle with a couple of friends. We're going to do lawn care in the local neighborhoods around our campus.
Woman: Oh wow, that sounds like a great idea.
Man: We were wondering if you'd like to join us.
Woman: Doing what, though? I don't have much experience with lawn mowers.
Man: That's okay, it doesn't have to be mowing. You could keep the books or make appointments. We're open to different options.
Woman: I'm on my way to class now, but I'll call you this afternoon.

questions.stem: What does the man invite the woman to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士邀请女士做什么？ 定位原文：Man: We were wondering if you'd like to join us. ... You could keep the books or make appointments. We're open to different options. 选项分析： A. 见他的朋友们。男士邀请她加入团队一起工作，而不是仅仅见面，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 和他一起工作。男士明确询问她是否愿意加入（join us），并说明可以负责记账或预约等工作，因此 B 选项正确。 C. 参观当地的社区。男士提到要在校园周边的社区做草坪护理，但并未邀请她去参观，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 借一本书。对话中没有提到任何书籍，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention lawn mowers?

options.A: To identify a lack of skill

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士为什么提到割草机？ 定 位 原 文 ： Woman: Doing what, though? I don't have much experience with lawn mowers. 选项分析： A. 为了表明自己缺乏技能。女士说自己对割草机没有太多经验，这是在说明自己可能不适合做割草的工作，因此 A 选项正确。 B. 为了描述一个新的兴趣。她没有表达对割草机的兴趣，而是表达缺乏经验，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 为了提出一个建议。她没有建议任何事情，只是在说明自己的情况，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 为了讨论最近的购买。她没有提到购买割草机，因此 D 选项错误。
